operational_definitions.terminal_trace: A maximal visible, nonbranching passage from a depicted free tip/cap back to the first visible joining region or a boundary at which the passage loses separate traceability. It must be demonstrable as one channel by a centerline plus two separated transverse boundary witnesses, or as one clearly drawn single stroke. An unresolved patch is not silently converted into such a channel.
operational_definitions.not_a_terminal_trace: A pointed corner, scallop, serration, colour spot or internal hatch on one continuous area is not by itself an independently traceable channel. Do not call it a leaf or manufacture a stem/neck by cutting the outline. If either interpretation is plausible, retain the alternative and do not certify a count.
operational_definitions.maximal_and_nonoverlap: Do not split a single nonbranching passage at colour changes or width changes. Distinct trace IDs require distinct free ends and separable paths before a visible merger. If several ends share a tail, that tail is one shared connector record, not several independent full paths.
operational_definitions.joining_region: A bounded local region where at least three separately traceable channels visibly meet. Trace both edges of an outlined channel as one arm. A crossing/overlap with hidden continuity is unresolved, not a certified join. A broad painted body is not collapsed into a hidden junction merely because projections touch it.
operational_definitions.body_attachment: Where a terminal channel enters a broad painted/outlined area and the remaining route is not separately visible, record an attachment port and body-region candidate, then stop the path. The broad area is a region, not an invented branching point or biological organ. Inseparable body boundaries may have multiple candidate envelopes.
operational_definitions.relative_arrangement: Store terminal endpoint, attachment/join interval and path witnesses in original image x/y. Also normalize to the fixed context rectangle for navigation, not morphological equivalence. Record endpoint left/right/up/down from its own attachment only when coordinate uncertainty intervals are disjoint; otherwise axis relation unresolved. Do not choose a main stem, optimize rotation/reflection, impose bilateral pairing or infer historical biological orientation.
operational_definitions.local_versus_whole: Each witnessed trace/join is a local claim. Whole-entry counts require a complete scan of the frozen entry scope and explicit accounting for unsegmented/obscured regions. A full viewport does not imply every part is measurable.

minimal_records: Per entry: full fixed unit and source/view receipt, scanned/unreviewed masks or rectangles.

Per certified or ambiguous candidate terminal: ID, endpoint/cap bbox, polyline to first join/body boundary, two channel witnesses or single-stroke declaration, attachment target(s), evidence status and uncertainty reason.
Per visible join/body region: ID, bbox/polygon, incident trace IDs with separate connection status.

Per entry: certified terminal/join count lower bounds; exact count only under exhaustive coverage; admissible upper bound only if all ambiguous alternatives are finite, otherwise null. Coordinate relations are descriptive only.
uncertainty_rules: A record stores explicit alternatives when two endpoints could be one cap or an apparent branch could be outline edges. No majority vote or forced preferred alternative.
Certified lower bounds count distinct witnessed paths only. Unknown upper bound is null, never the observed lower bound or zero. Shared tails and candidate equivalences are retained by IDs.
Dust, text, crack or paint damage alternatives remain named; do not erase text or complete missing lines.
Zero whole-entry count requires a completed scan with no qualifying or unresolved channel candidates. An unsegmentable broad area makes the affected upper bound unknown.
No confidence interval, bootstrap, pair contrast or semantic prediction is computed.

view_plan.allowed_sources: Exact old JPEGs and pinned old four entry contexts; existing native detail crops if needed. At most one additional integer crop per entry from the same source, solely to document a fixed ambiguous attachment, with source coordinates and SHA.
prohibited: No image enhancement, generated reconstruction, rotation or upscaling measurement
No main nine Voynich feature records
view_plan.actual_view_requirement: Each actually observed display must be separately receipted; producing a crop does not count as viewing. Automatic whole-display resizing is navigation only; original coordinates are used for detail witnesses.

time_budget.start_event: Only after root explicitly approves this exact proposal version and input hashes
time_budget.at_stop: Freeze all four rows; unfinished regions remain not_reviewed. Do not rush them into NA_after_review or extend the budget because a difficult entry is important.

failure_criteria: If a certified terminal/join cannot be furnished with distinct path/arm coordinate witnesses, downgrade it to unresolved and report representation failure for that claim.

If any entry cannot exhaustively delimit its candidate terminals and joins within budget, precise whole-entry counts are not established for the four-entry instrument. Local records may still be usable; do not present complete measurement success.
If two reasonable partitions remain and require an arbitrary main-axis, biological leaf/root assumption or new width threshold to select, record alternatives and stop short of a unique graph.

If traceable and outline-only details cannot be consistently distinguished using the same written definition across four entries, report that this version is not yet operational; do not patch it per entry.
success_scope: At most an implementable descriptive annotation format with explicit local witnesses and remaining ambiguity. Even four complete records do not establish reproducibility, name discrimination, general sensitivity or biological validity.
immutability: No existing source, plan, feature definition, 48-cell main matrix, 16-cell control matrix or new six-entry roster may be overwritten.
planned_context_note: planned_context copies the old generation receipt verbatim. Its actually_viewed=false was a pre-view generation status; old actual viewing is documented in known_language_control/observation_v1.json. No new view is implied.
